name: Seereth Stonebreak
summary: Near Greatwood Vale, Seereth Stonebreak watches the land's troubles. The orc shaman camps on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, guiding travelers through threats to the wilds and the Horde's presence.

sections.title: A Watchful Shaman
sections.body: From her camp near Greatwood Vale, Seereth Stonebreak watches over Horde lands. She is an orc shaman who follows the elements' harmony and guards the Horde's territories. When the land's spirits cried out against goblin plunder, the Horde sent her to Stonetalon. Now she watches the landscape and guides travelers through dangers on the wild frontier.

sections.title: Turmoil in Stonetalon
sections.body: Across the Stonetalon range, ruthless goblin ventures and mechanical shredders cut through ancient woodlands. Their work has badly shaken the mountains' spiritual balance. Seereth sends Horde envoys to confront the invaders and seek counsel from elder lorekeepers. She hopes their efforts will ease the land's distress.

faq.answer: Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman in the Horde. She guides travelers heading toward the Stonetalon Mountains against threats to the land and the Horde's presence.

faq.q: Why is Seereth concerned about the Stonetalon Mountains?
faq.answer: The Stonetalon Mountains suffer from rampant deforestation, aggressive goblin logging machinery, and rising conflict. Seereth senses the local spirits' agitation and works to halt the devastation.

faq.q: What happened to her original post?
faq.answer: Seereth's original post remains near Greatwood Vale, on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens. The Horde sent her to Stonetalon, and her camp lies along the road west of the Crossroads.

faq.q: What tasks does Seereth offer to adventurers?
faq.answer: Seereth sends Horde adventurers into Stonetalon to confront Venture Company goblins, dismantle destructive shredding machines, commune with troubled spirits, and consult respected elders such as Magatha Grimtotem.

faq.q: Who is the Elder Crone she mentions?
faq.answer: The Elder Crone is Magatha Grimtotem, a powerful and influential tauren elder who lives on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Seereth seeks her guidance on deep spiritual disturbances.

faq.q: Why is she concerned with goblin operations?
faq.answer: Seereth is troubled because goblin logging operations use mechanical shredders to tear through sacred forests, pollute waterways, and enrage the nature spirits she is sworn to appease.

angles.text: As a shaman, you share Seereth's duty to heal Stonetalon's environmental scars and soothe its agitated spirits.
As a member of the Horde, you help protect critical overland routes and resources from Alliance forces and reckless goblin operations.
As an orc, you share Seereth's return to shamanism and reverence for the natural world, against mindless destruction.
